excerpts.text:
return (
    <Accordion.Root collapsible>
      {items.map((item, index) => (
        <Accordion.Item key={index} value={item.value}>
          <Accordion.ItemTrigger>
            <Stack gap="1">
              <Text>{item.title}</Text>
              <Text fontSize="sm" color="fg.muted">
                Click to expand
              </Text>
            </Stack>
          </Accordion.ItemTrigger>
          <Accordion.ItemContent>
            <Accordion.ItemBody>{item.text}</Accordion.ItemBody>
          </Accordion.ItemContent>
        </Accordion.Item>
      ))}
    </Accordion.Root>

synthesis.guidance: Adapt Root/Item/ItemTrigger/ItemContent/ItemBody to real settings: identify the setting in the title and summarize its current value or consequence on a short second line. The story uses Stack gap="1" and Text fontSize="sm" color="fg.muted" to establish hierarchy without another bordered card. Replace "Click to expand" with input-neutral, informative copy, and replace LoremIpsum with actual content. Use stable item IDs as React keys, not the example index. Check muted-text contrast in both themes, focus visibility and wrapping at narrow widths. Let application typography and spacing set the rhythm rather than repeating marketing tiles. The excerpt depends on Chakra and surrounding items data; it is not standalone code.

synthesis.summary: An accordion trigger stacks a title with smaller muted subtext, while the body lives in ItemContent/ItemBody. Useful for compact preferences and setup screens.
